item.title: Calling my AI agent on WhatsApp
item.description: I built a way to phone my personal AI agent over WhatsApp. A realtime voice answers, hands real work to a fresh Claude Opus chat, and speaks the result back. Here is the architecture, the bugs, and the risks.

item.title: Claude as the brain of my AI agent
item.description: How I run Hermes Agent on Claude: which model does what, how work fans out to subagents, what caching and fallbacks do, and what broke along the way.
